same_settings_baseline.note: DO NOT READ 94 -> 85 AS A t-0825 REGRESSION. The entire -9 is eval-001 (17 -> 8), and the t-0825 change is hard-scoped to message-like ASSERTs (both _message_outcome_conflict call sites are action==ASSERT gated) - it cannot affect the eval-001 FILL/CLICK picks that collapsed. This run's eval-001 skeleton is a bad LLM draw: it navigates to cart.html directly, resolves 'Checkout' to #react-burger-menu-btn (the burger menu) and 'First Name'/'Last Name'/'Zip Code' to .product_sort_container (a sort dropdown). The deterministic static gate is 91/96 = 94.8% both before and after t-0825. The same-settings band is 89-92/113; 85 sits below it as an outlier low draw. eval-010 c3 did NOT flip to the golden: the t-0825 floor rejected the #order-error trap (it worked), but the journey page-cursor defect (test_04's journey replays 'Place Order' on success.html, picks #back-to-store, and returns to index.html before scraping the success message) left #order-success-title out of scope, so the resolver emitted a degraded full-page :has-text(...) instead. The cursor defect predates t-0825 (2026-10-13 has the same expected_page=index.html on that assert). See docs/sessions/2026-10-15_heldout_remeasure.md.

flaky_story.note: eval-004's external site is slow and flaky.
